title: 2022: 59 CENTS
subtitle: Household price per kWh, in euro cents

lines.say: In early 2008, a Danish household paid 26 cents for a kilowatt-hour of electricity.
For years, the price crept up slowly.
Then, in the second half of 2022, gas prices soared, and Danish electricity hit 59 cents a kilowatt-hour. More than twice the 2008 price.
The EU average peaked later, in early 2024, at 29 cents.
Now Denmark has cut its electricity tax almost to zero, and it pays 24 cents. Less than the EU average of 28.
The whole story of Europe's power prices is in our full video.
